svg.text: NLP Support System — End-to-End System Architecture (Level 2)
FastAPI Microservice (Render) • Next.js Frontend (Vercel) • Supabase pgvector • 5-Agent Orchestration (A1–A5)
Output: {intent, category, confidence, margin, top3, top1_sim}
• Plans next steps from intent, uncertainty (conf < 0.50, margin < 0.15), evidence
• Required-slot check (e.g. order number for get_refund / track_order)
• Combines A1 confidence/margin + A3 plan + A4 verdict; resolves conflicts
{decision, message, trace: [A1, A3, A2?, A4?, A5], total_latency_ms, retrieval_backend}
Total ≈ 65–180ms • A2 and A4 are skipped when A3 plans clarify / escalate
• If Supabase is unreachable (>2s), A2 falls back to the in-memory index;
• A3, A4 and A5 are rule-based: no extra DB or LLM calls on the hot path.
• Telemetry is async, so logging never blocks the response.
• Never claims an order, payment, refund or account was changed — completed-action phrases are stripped or rewritten. • Raw {{placeholders}} never reach the customer.
• "I need a refund but cannot find my order number" → CLARIFY (asks for details). • ESCALATE recommends human review; it never claims the issue is resolved.
